seen: A fitness-app ad that opens like a body diagnosis: a trainer stands behind a woman and points at her stomach, caption "All plus-size girls need to do this to get rid of belly fat". It then cuts to an app screen ('Lazy easy workout') with a short routine list while a woman does the moves on a bed. The format points at a visible sign, names its cause, then shows the fix.

beats.said: This is hormone back and this is sitting all day legs and this is stress belly. The best way to fix them isn't go to the gym.
All you need to do this workout game routine at home every single day.
